_doc: STAGED proposal -- NOT applied. A reviewer wires this at STOP-B; this file never touches params.json / fleet_executor.py.

mechanism.wiring_point: automation/state/fleet/fleet_executor.py: _qty_for(tiers, equity, elite) is called at 3 sites (plan_entry ~L237, _plan_from_strategies ~L322, plan_all ~L376), each as `qty = _qty_for(params.get('position_sizing_tiers'), float(equity), elite)`. Proposed: wrap the RESULT with a new `_apply_recency_policy(qty, strategy_name, params, day_verdict)` that, when params['recency_sizing_policy']['enabled'] is true and strategy_name matches, rescales qty per sizing_tier(day_verdict) using this module's policy_qty() logic (RED -> floor 3, YELLOW -> 0.5x floor 3, GREEN -> unchanged). day_verdict itself needs a live daily-verdict producer (this module's compute_verdict, run once per session against the growing real-fills ledger) -- NOT built here (out of ANALYSIS ONLY scope); this proposal covers the SIZING mechanism only.
mechanism.min_contracts_consistency: RED_QTY=3 already equals params.min_contracts (the existing Rule-6 floor) -- RED does not go below what risk_gate already enforces as a minimum, it just stops any elite/tier upsize above it.

disclosures: Evidence base is SMALL BY CONSTRUCTION: 8 real trading days (2026-06-29..2026-07-09), not the ~25 sessions the task named as an approximate target -- fleet_rest real fills only go back to 2026-06-29. Directional evidence, not a standing ratification bar (same small-n honesty convention as recency_check.py's own DISCLOSURE.small_n).

qty->pnl scaling is LINEAR (pnl_per_contract * policy_qty) -- ignores any slippage/liquidity delta from trading fewer/more contracts (same simplifying assumption t4_exit_matrix.py / structure_stop_study.py already make at fixed qty).
enabled:false by design -- this is a STAGED shape, not a live flip. Ships for REVOKE per OP-0/OP-11 only after this JSON is reviewed at STOP-B.

CAVEAT: every trading day in the evaluation window verdicts RED (see distinct_verdicts_seen in recency-sizing-ab.json) -- this evidence base validates the RED->floor(3) mechanism only; the YELLOW->0.5x and GREEN->unchanged branches are UNTESTED by real data (no YELLOW/GREEN day occurred in the sample). Recommend the reviewer re-run this A/B once the real-fills window includes a verdict flip before treating this as validated across all three tiers.
